messages:
Alex Chen: Quick sync — SI GPU onramp + marketplace listing. Goal: launch first SI-certified cohort with HW partners by Apr 18. Need training dates, lab access, and joint announcement cadence. Who can own?
Priya Nair: I can own curriculum + cert blueprint. thinking a 2-week cohort: week1 = fundamentals & infra, week2 = hands-on labs + eval.
Marco Ruiz: I will own lab infra. Reaching out to GPU vendor for quota and test nodes. Tentative lab slots: Apr 1-12. Need VPN/VPC access plan from Private team.
Dana Lee: I’ll handle marketplace packaging & collateral. Need final cohort bullets to create listing + co-marketing kit. Can we lock the prize/discount for SIs?
Samir Patel: Certification exam: propose 20 q multiple choice + 2 practical tasks (deploy + performance tuning). We should publish the passing criteria. I can draft the exam matrix by Mar 20.
Alex Chen: @Priya + @Samir align on learning objectives and pass bar by Mar 15. @Marco confirm lab capacity by Mar 10. @Dana we need announcement copy + partner logos by Mar 22 for marketplace push.
Priya Nair: Draft learning objectives (high level): 1) Redwood serving fundamentals 2) Deployment modes (hosted/dedicated/private) 3) Cost/perf tradeoffs + Optimize toolkit 4) Integrations (marketplace, SI ops) 5) Troubleshooting playbook.
Marco Ruiz: Lab infra notes: will provision two GPU pools (A100 & H100), staging cluster + isolated VPC per SI team. Sample access snippet for engineers: ```ssh -i si_onramp.pem ubuntu@34.82.12.101``` Will add onboarding playbook for VPN.
Dana Lee: Marketplace checklist: product tile, 1-page solution brief, partner logo (svg), co-sell contact, listing tags (si, gpu, marketplace). Draft announcement copy: "Redwood + <SI> Certified Onramp — fast, secure LLM inference at scale."
Samir Patel: Exam matrix draft: 40% infra/config, 30% optimization/benchmarking, 20% troubleshooting, 10% security/compliance. Practical task 1: deploy model and hit P90 latency target. Practical task 2: configure batching/cache to reduce tokens cost by X%.
Alex Chen: Good. Two open questions: 1) timeline for vendor joint quote for lab pricing? 2) legal signoff for co-marketing asset use.
Marco Ruiz: Vendor quote: asked NVIDIA partner rep, they said ~5 business days. Will follow up Tue.
Priya Nair: Legal: @Dana can you loop in legal for logo usage & co-announcement template? We should also pre-approve a simple NDA for SIs to get lab creds.
Dana Lee: On it — looping legal. Also booking a 30m partner sync next Wed 9am PT to review collateral. I’ll send calendar invite after I get cert bullets. :calendar:
partners-bot: ACTION ITEMS: [Priya] curriculum + objectives by 2026-03-15, [Samir] exam matrix by 2026-03-20, [Marco] lab capacity & vendor quote by 2026-03-10, [Dana] marketplace listing + legal coord by 2026-03-22.
Alex Chen: Thanks team — plan to run a pilot cohort Apr 3-14, announce Apr 18. Follow-ups in the partner sync. If anyone needs more cycles on content, flag here. :rocket:
Priya Nair: Quick promo tweet draft: "Excited to launch Redwood SI Onramp in partnership with our hardware partners — apply now for the Apr cohort: https://redwood.ai/si-onramp"
Samir Patel: Also adding a small rubric for judges on practical tasks — will share by tomorrow.
Marco Ruiz: FYI I'll post lab firewall rules + sample terraform for VPC peering in the next message.
Dana Lee: Cool. I'll prepare a one-pager partner-facing FAQ to include with marketplace listing.
Alex Chen: Great. Closing this thread — see invite. If anything blocks, reopen here.
